quote: The PR author must establish that consuming the persisted spawn-owner bit cannot authorize a later non-owner follow-up or work whose parent authority has expired before native dispatch.
note: The first review’s “Resolve merge risk” item questioned stale parent authority before native dispatch, and the author responded by removing the stored spawn-owner bit. The shipped bug used the senderIsOwner flag captured at admission, which let an already-running subagent retain native access after its spawner lost ownership.
